task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Using QuTiP, build a cat state (|alpha> + |-alpha>)/norm with alpha=2.11 in a 25-dimensional Fock space and print its Wigner function values on a coarse grid, identifying the interference fringes. Write the full runnable code (all imports included); executing it should print the results.
